#packages

```{r}
library(sf)
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(janitor)
library(countrycode)
```

#read data

```{r}
HDR25 <- read_csv(here::here("HDR25_Composite_indices_complete_time_series.csv"))

#could add skip=0, but we only need this code when we need to delete the 1st row.

WORLD <- st_read(here::here("World_Countries_(Generalized)_2173680399808997149.geojson"))
```

#subset and join data

```{r}
GII_subset <- HDR25%>% 
  clean_names()%>%
  select(iso3, country, gii_2010, gii_2019)%>%
  mutate(gii_diff = gii_2019 - gii_2010)%>%
  filter(str_detect(iso3, "^ZZ", negate = TRUE))%>%
  mutate(ISO = (countrycode(iso3, origin = "iso3c", destination = "iso2c")))

WORLD_GII <- WORLD %>% left_join(GII_subset, by = "ISO")
```
